<mxfile host="app.diagrams.net" agent="Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/146.0.0.0 Safari/537.36" version="29.6.6" pages="2" scale="1" border="0"> <diagram name="Page-1" id="TErw7xku6lbws7bSCE8m"> <mxGraphModel dx="1016" dy="451" grid="1" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" page="1" pageScale="1" pageWidth="827" pageHeight="1169" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> </root> </mxGraphModel> </diagram> <diagram id="Lc-5hkURfKIPSvPZbW7Z" name="Page-2"> <mxGraphModel dx="1747" dy="1002" grid="1" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" page="1" pageScale="1" pageWidth="827" pageHeight="1169" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <UserObject label="" plantUmlData="{
 "data": "@startuml
left to right direction
skinparam packageStyle rectangle
skinparam usecase {
 BackgroundColor #E8F8F5
 BorderColor #117A65
 ArrowColor #2C3E50
}
skinparam actorStyle hollow

actor \"Physician\" as Doc
actor \"Registered Nurse\" as Nurse
actor \"System Admin\" as Admin
actor \"Registered Patient\" as Patient
actor \"External Lab Partner\" as ExtLab

rectangle \"NovaHealth EHR Platform\" {
 usecase \"Authenticate Access\" as UC_Auth
 usecase \"Remote VPN Access\" as UC_VPN
 usecase \"Trigger MFA Challenge\" as UC_MFA

 usecase \"Access Patient Record\" as UC_ViewRec
 usecase \"Modify Prescription\" as UC_Prescribe
 usecase \"Create Discharge Record\" as UC_Discharge
 usecase \"Manage Lab Diagnostics\" as UC_Labs

 usecase \"View Health Overview\" as UC_Summary
 usecase \"Export Medical Files\" as UC_Download

 usecase \"Execute EHR Backup\" as UC_Backup
 usecase \"Monitor Network Activity\" as UC_Monitor
 usecase \"Apply Workstation Patches\" as UC_Patch

 ' Include Relationships
 UC_Prescribe .> UC_ViewRec : <<include>>
 UC_Discharge .> UC_ViewRec : <<include>>
 UC_Summary .> UC_ViewRec : <<include>>
 UC_Labs .> UC_ViewRec : <<include>>

 ' Extend Relationships
 UC_VPN .> UC_Auth : <<extend>>
 UC_MFA .> UC_Auth : <<extend>>
 UC_Download .> UC_Summary : <<extend>>
}

' Actor Connections
Doc --> UC_Auth
Doc --> UC_ViewRec
Doc --> UC_Prescribe
Doc --> UC_Discharge
Doc --> UC_Labs

Nurse --> UC_Auth
Nurse --> UC_ViewRec
Nurse --> UC_Labs

Patient --> UC_Summary
Patient --> UC_Download
Patient --> UC_ViewRec

ExtLab --> UC_Labs

Admin --> UC_Backup
Admin --> UC_Monitor
Admin --> UC_Patch
@enduml",
 "format": "svg"
}" id="cc6bCqg-42s_VdnUkoPt-2"> <mxCell parent="1" style="shape=image;noLabel=1;verticalAlign=top;aspect=fixed;imageAspect=0;image=data:image/svg+xml,;" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="1010" width="511.31" x="70" y="140" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> </UserObject> </root> </mxGraphModel> </diagram> </mxfile>

svg.style: width: 486px; height: 960px; background: rgb(255, 255, 255); font-family: initial;
